paragraphs: (Ammiel son of Gemalli, Numbers 13:12.) Abba Elazar ben Gamla (a Tanna): Gittin 30b; Beitzah 13b reads ben Gimel.
Rabbi Chanina ben Gamla: Sanhedrin 111a (and Hyman says it should read ben Gamliel there).

notes.text: The consulted passages have Gemalli in Numbers, Gamla in Gittin, Gimel in Beitzah and Chanina ben Gamla in Sanhedrin. Gamliel is Hyman’s proposed correction in Sanhedrin.
